heroSummary: Grades 1–12 begin August 24, while kindergarten starts August 27 after three full interview days. The district counts 173 instructional days for grades 1–12 and three fewer for kindergarten; Spring Recess leads directly into Good Friday and a March 29 staff-development day.
seoTitle: SDP Calendar 2026-2027: Start Date, Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: View the School District of Philadelphia 2026-2027 calendar for parents and families, including first day, kindergarten dates, holidays, breaks, PDF and ICS downloads.
calendarNotes: The School District of Philadelphia starts the 2026-2027 school year for students in grades 1-12 on August 24, 2026. Kindergarten interview days run August 24-26, and the first day for kindergarten students is August 27, 2026. The last day for students is June 9, 2027. Winter Recess runs December 23, 2026 through January 1, 2027. Spring Recess runs March 22-25, 2027, followed by Good Friday on March 26 and a professional development day on March 29. The PDF lists 173 student days for grades 1-12; kindergarten students have three fewer annual instructional days because of full-day interview days at the start of the year.

calendarFaqs.q: When does SDP start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The School District of Philadelphia starts the 2026-2027 school year for students in grades 1-12 on Monday, August 24, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When does kindergarten start for SDP in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Kindergarten interview days run August 24-26, 2026, and the first day of school for kindergarten students is Thursday, August 27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SDP Winter Recess in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: SDP Winter Recess runs from Wednesday, December 23, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SDP Spring Recess in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: SDP Spring Recess runs from Monday, March 22 through Thursday, March 25, 2027. Good Friday on March 26 is also a school closure.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the SDP 2026-2027 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The SDP 2026-2027 academic calendar lists 173 student days for grades 1-12. Kindergarten students have three fewer annual instructional days because of full-day interview days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for SDP in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for students is Wednesday, June 9, 2027, and the calendar marks it as a full day.

customSections.label: Who This SDP Calendar Is For
customSections.content: This SDP calendar page is designed for Philadelphia parents planning childcare and vacations, students checking school holidays and recesses, teachers tracking districtwide dates, and families comparing school-year schedules. It summarizes districtwide academic dates; school-specific events should be confirmed with individual schools.

customSections.label: SDP Calendar Important Dates for Families
customSections.content: Families usually check the SDP calendar first for the grades 1-12 first day, kindergarten interview days, kindergarten first day, school closures, report card conference days, staff professional development days, Winter Recess, Spring Recess, testing windows, graduation window, and the last day of school. These dates affect childcare, transportation, work schedules, appointments, and family travel in Philadelphia.

customSections.label: SDP School Closures and Days Off Explained
customSections.content: Families often use the SDP calendar to identify days when students may not attend school, including full recess periods, holidays, staff-only dates, report card conference days, and kindergarten interview days. Some dates affect all students, while other dates may apply differently by grade level or school program.

groups.label: Why these dates matter
items: They affect childcare coverage, transportation, after-school programs, work schedules, and family travel plans.
Families should confirm school-specific notices because individual schools may publish additional events, testing details, ceremonies, or program calendars.

customSections.label: SDP Calendar Download and Print Guide
customSections.content: Use the SDP calendar tools to view the official PDF source, download a printable calendar, import an ICS file into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook, and share school-year dates with family members. Calendar downloads are helpful for planning, but they should be checked against official SDP updates before important plans.

groups.label: How to use SDP calendar downloads
items: Download the PDF when you need a printable SDP calendar for home, work, or school planning.
Import the ICS file into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook to add districtwide dates to a personal calendar.
Share key dates with family members who help with transportation, childcare, or after-school pickup.
Check the official School District of Philadelphia calendar page before relying on saved copies for urgent schedule decisions.

customSections.label: SDP Calendar Planning Guide for Families
customSections.content: The SDP calendar is most useful when families connect dates to real planning needs. Winter Recess, Spring Recess, professional development dates, report card conferences, and kindergarten interview days are the dates most likely to affect childcare, travel, transportation, and work schedules.
